title: Dreams about schools
content: I'm a former public school teacher and obviously a former student. I've had more vivid dreams than I can count that take place in schools. Sometimes I'm the teacher, but more frequently, it seems I'm the student or that I switch between roles. Very common themes are I'm a student who forgot my schedule or a teacher who doesn't have a lesson plan for the day. I also occasionally have mall dreams or swimming pool dreams.
